language.label: Language
error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
editor.heading: New job
editor.lead: Gerber ZIP or KiCad PCB file in, exposure file (.pm3) and drill/mill G-code out. Add one or more boards, set how many copies you want, check the plate and create the job.
editor.load_failed: {message} Reload the page to try again.
boards.title: Boards
boards.drop: Drop Gerber ZIP or KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) files here or
boards.limits_one: Up to {files} files of {mb} MB and {boards} boards per job. Files are kept for {count} day.
boards.limits_other: Up to {files} files of {mb} MB and {boards} boards per job. Files are kept for {count} days.
boards.empty: No boards yet. Add the .kicad_pcb file of a board (zones filled), or export B.Cu, Edge.Cuts and the drill files from KiCad into one ZIP per board.
boards.order_hint: The order of the list is the order on the plate and in the G-code.
boards.only_zip: Only Gerber ZIP or KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) files are accepted.
boards.too_large: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
settings.title: Settings
settings.calibration_hint: Values of your printer profile. Change them only after measuring a test exposure.
settings.flip: How the plate is turned over
settings.tabs: Tabs hold the boards in the plate
plate.title: Plate
plate.hint_top: Design view as in KiCad (seen from above): the copper side (B.Cu) is at the bottom. Holes are coloured by diameter.
plate.hint_bottom: Underside: the copper side seen from below, mirrored left to right compared with the design view. Copper tracks, pads and pours, the boards and the holes (coloured by diameter) are shown.
plate.check_inputs: Check the copies, the gap and the margin.
plate.summary_one: {count} board on a {width} × {height} mm plate, {usage} % of the area used.
plate.summary_other: {count} boards on a {width} × {height} mm plate, {usage} % of the area used.
job.heading: Job
job.queued: Waiting in the queue. This page updates itself.
job.running: Creating the files. This page updates itself.
job.unreachable: Cannot reach the server, trying again ...
job.not_found: This job does not exist or has expired.
job.done_one: Done. The files are kept for about one more day. Keep this link, it is the only way to get them back.
job.done_other: Done. The files are kept for about {count} more days. Keep this link, it is the only way to get them back.
job.mask_alt: Exposure mask: white exposes, black stays copper
job.mask_caption: Mask as sent to the printer (white = exposed).
job.pm3_note: Copy it to the printer (USB stick) and print.
job.mill_alt: Plate with board outlines and holes
job.mill_caption: Plate on the mill bed with board outlines and holes (colour = diameter).
job.programs_hint: One program per tool, run them in this order. Each program first moves to the tool change position (X0 Y0, high up) and pauses with the spindle off: insert the tool, set Z0 to the plate surface and resume the program in your control software. At the end it parks at the same position.
job.program_mill: {step}. End mill {diameter} mm (large holes, cutouts and board outlines)
job.copy_manually: Copy the address from the address bar
tools.heading: Tool library
tools.lead: Drill bits and end mills the G-code is made for. A hole gets the drill of the same diameter; larger holes are milled with the end mill. Cutting values are starting values, tune them on your mill.
sim.title: 3D simulation of the drill and mill paths
sim.hint: Drag to turn the view, drag with the middle mouse button to move it, mouse wheel or the buttons to zoom. With the view in focus: arrow keys turn, + and - zoom, space starts and stops.
sim.load_failed: The programs could not be loaded.
sim.aria: 3D view of the plate with the tool paths
sim.position: Tool at X {x}, Y {y}, Z {z} mm
sim.note: The time is estimated from the feed rates of the programs; rapid moves are assumed at {rapid} mm/min. The depth is exaggerated so that it can be seen. Dark lines show where material is cut away.
machines.heading: Machines
machines.lead: Parameters of the printers and mills the files are made for. Calibration values can be changed for a single job under Settings on the New job page.
machines.m_offset: Plate position on the machine (X, Y)
settings.marks: Positioning marks on the copper layer
settings.marks_hint: Two marks diagonally opposite in the margin show the position and the rotation of the plate on the mill. The lower left mark, set as close to the boards as possible, is X0 Y0 of the G-code. Needs a margin of at least 4.5 mm.
plate.marks_margin: Positioning marks need a margin of at least {min} mm.
job.marks_on: lower left mark = X0 Y0, upper right mark at X {x}, Y {y} mm
job.marks_hint: Positioning marks: find the centre of the lower left mark (where the tips of the two quarter circles touch), set X0 Y0 there and check the centre of the upper right mark at X {x}, Y {y} mm. If it is off, the plate is turned: turn it until both fit.
settings.mark_labels: Coordinates next to the positioning marks
job.archive_hint: Everything in one ZIP archive, in the folders exposure and drill-mill.
drills.title: Drills for odd hole sizes
drills.hint: The tool library has no drill for these hole sizes. Choose which drill is used for them. A smaller drill makes the holes too small, a larger one too big.
drills.row: Holes of {diameter} mm ({count}×) are drilled with
